summary: HypoExplorer estimates the hypothalamic Treg diet effect across four BL/6 pools per diet. Figure 3f reports 19 selected gene ratios from one pool of nine female BALB/c mice per diet. The BL/6 figures answer different questions, and inspection of all 67 GEO sample files found only per-library quantifications. The closure proposal and evidence checks passed. [Published study](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-025-57918-z)
openIssues: Author concordance remains unassessed. Reopen if an author table, code output, or labelled panel identifies the registered BL/6 hypothalamic Treg libraries and gives gene-level HFHS-versus-standard-diet effects or directions.
